milestone.title: M169 review remediations — Tab/click on Settings wipes staged edits, set_config_value coercion shadow, partial-commit silent, AC-01 wrap, HashMap order

intent.outcome: After this ships, the M169 review findings F-01..F-05 (Entry 30 in mp-dogfood-log.md) are all resolved. Pressing Tab or clicking the Settings tab while staged edits exist preserves them (no silent reload). The set_config_value / mp config set coercion surface produces the same on-disk type as the in-memory staged row (no string→bool flicker). apply_settings_save rolls back partial commits and surfaces a clear error on commit-time failure. AC-01 lane-nav wrap is implemented and tested. apply_settings_save iterates staged_edits in deterministic key order.

problem.description: M169 shipped green tests (522 raul + 2328 full-suite) but the live TUI quietly wipes staged edits on Tab/click-on-Settings (AC-06 violation), shadows mp's parse_bool coercion while staging (so the row shows 'yes' but on-disk becomes true), silently commits a partial batch on save errors, never implements the AC-01 lane-wrap, and iterates HashMap without sort (non-deterministic JSON diff). All five are real defects surfaceable in a single TUI session; the existing test suite does not pin any of them. Entry 30 in mp-dogfood-log.md documents repro recipes for all four findings.

in_scope: Fix F-01 (HIGH, AC-06 violation): in Action::NextLane (crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs:234) and Action::JumpLane, skip the load_data_for_lane() call when the target lane is the active lane AND the lane holds mutable user state (Settings). Concretely: introduce a `lane_state_owned_by_user(lane) -> bool` predicate and gate the load_data_for_lane() call on its negation. Mouse-click on the Settings tab while already on Settings must also skip the reload.

Fix F-02 (MEDIUM, set_config_value shadow): refactor apply_settings_commit_edit (crates/raul/src/tui/action.rs:529-543) and apply_settings_save (action.rs:548-592) to route ALL staged_edits through a single parse_via_mp(value, key_path) helper that shells out to `mp config set --dry-run <key> <value>` and reads back the coerced value via stdout. Drop the local true/false/i64/f64 fall-through in set_config_value (action.rs:616-638). The in-memory staged row shows the coerced value (no flicker).

Fix F-03 (MEDIUM, partial commit): in apply_settings_save, if commit k fails after commit k-1 succeeded, roll back the k-1 commit by re-reading the on-disk config and writing the pre-batch snapshot. Surface a focused flash_message: `Partial save failed: {error}. Rolled back {k-1} of {N} edits.` Update AC-05 description to require the rollback.

Fix F-04 (LOW, AC-01 wrap): in tab_move_down / tab_move_up (app.rs:992-1008) implement the wrap — on Tab at the last lane, advance to the first lane (and symmetrically for Shift+Tab at lane 0). Add a unit test tab_wrap_at_ends_cycles_to_first_lane and shift_tab_wrap_at_start_cycles_to_last_lane.

Fix F-05 (LOW, HashMap iteration order): change staged_edits from HashMap<String, String> to BTreeMap<String, String> in app.rs SettingsState. Update apply_settings_save to iterate the BTreeMap (already deterministic). Add a test that asserts dry-run + commit order are key-sorted.

Add crates/raul/tests/m169_review_remediations.rs with at least 5 end-to-end tests: (1) tab_on_settings_preserves_staged_edits, (2) yes_for_bool_field_keeps_coerced_value_in_memory, (3) partial_save_failure_rolls_back_committed_edits, (4) tab_at_last_lane_wraps_to_first, (5) staged_edits_iterated_in_key_order. Add crates/raul/tests/repro_recipes from dogfood-log Entry 30 verbatim as test pins.
After each fix lands, resolve the corresponding dogfood-log reference (the F-01..F-05 numbering is the closed milestone's finding namespace, not new B-NN entries).
out_of_scope: Reverting M169's Settings-as-lane design — the design is correct; the bugs are in the lane-agnostic dispatcher's coupling to lane state, not in the lane choice itself.
Touching Action::PrevLane or non-Tab lane navigation paths — same fix applies if symptoms reproduce, but Entry 30 only surfaced Tab + mouse-click.
Removing set_config_value entirely — it's still used by other paths (auto-rehydrate on save); only the staging path is being rewritten.
Touching the Settings UI chrome (footer affordances, grouped flat list, BF-03 layout from M169) — preserved.
Adding a global 'rollback last save' action — F-03 is automatic rollback on commit failure; an explicit user-driven undo is a different track.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing Tab on the Settings lane while staged edits exist preserves the edits; the Settings pane re-renders with the same staged state. The same applies to a mouse-click on the Settings tab while on Settings. (F-01 closed.)
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cargo nextest run -p raul -E 'test(/tab_on_settings_preserves_staged_edits|click_on_settings_preserves_staged_edits/)' --no-fail-fast ; all green ; manual smoke: open Settings, stage `ui.color = no`, press Tab → staged edit still highlighted ; press Tab again → overview ; press Tab → back to Settings ; edit still staged [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]

acceptance_criteria.description: Staging `ui.color = yes` shows the coerced value (`true`) in the row buffer while editing, not the raw string `yes`. The on-disk save produces the bool `true` (mp's parse_bool coercion). (F-02 closed.)
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cargo nextest run -p raul -E 'test(/yes_for_bool_field_keeps_coerced_value|set_config_value_matches_mp_parse_bool/)' --no-fail-fast ; all green [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]

acceptance_criteria.description: apply_settings_save rolls back any committed edit when a later edit in the batch fails. The footer flash surfaces `Partial save failed: {error}. Rolled back {k-1} of {N} edits.` (F-03 closed.)
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cargo nextest run -p raul -E 'test(/partial_save_failure_rolls_back/)' --no-fail-fast ; all green [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]

acceptance_criteria.description: Pressing Tab on the last lane (`Lane::ordered().last()`) advances active_lane to the first lane; Shift+Tab on lane 0 cycles to the last lane. The wrap is symmetric. (F-04 closed.)
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cargo nextest run -p raul -E 'test(/tab_wrap_at_ends_cycles|shift_tab_wrap_at_start_cycles/)' --no-fail-fast ; all green [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]

acceptance_criteria.description: staged_edits is BTreeMap<String, String>; apply_settings_save iterates it in key-sorted order; the on-disk config diff is deterministic across runs. (F-05 closed.)
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cargo nextest run -p raul -E 'test(/staged_edits_iterated_in_key_order/)' --no-fail-fast ; all green [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]

acceptance_criteria.description: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast is green (522 → ≥527, 5 new tests) ; cargo nextest run --no-fail-fast --manifest-path Cargo.toml remains green (2328 → ≥2333) ; cargo clippy --manifest-path Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings clean ; cargo fmt --all -- --check clean ; mp validate exits 0.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast ; cargo nextest run --no-fail-fast --manifest-path Cargo.toml ; cargo clippy --manifest-path Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings ; cargo fmt --all -- --check ; mp validate

acceptance_criteria.description: crates/raul/tests/repro_recipes.rs (or M169_review_remediations.rs) carries the verbatim repro recipes from mp-dogfood-log.md Entry 30 (the `tab_on_settings_wipes_staged_edits` and `yes_for_bool_field_keeps_string_in_memory_state` test bodies) as regression pins. Future AC-tampering cannot re-introduce the bugs without breaking the tests.
acceptance_criteria.verification: manual: cargo nextest run -p raul -E 'test(/repro_recipes|tab_on_settings_wipes_staged_edits|yes_for_bool_field/)' --no-fail-fast ; all green (negative-control tests: assert the bug doesn't reappear) [manual-auto-prefix: 2026-07-16]
